methodology.averaging: Case mean within seed, then arithmetic mean of three seeds. Gap always train minus validation.
methodology.stored_units: Correctness/agreement/Dice/fuzzy truth/adherence are fractions or [0,1] scores, not percentages. MSE/BCE are raw losses. Gaps use native metric units; multiply fraction gaps by100 for percentage points.
methodology.uncertainty: Descriptive; repeated seeds/cases/epochs are not independent samples; validation selected checkpoints, no independent test set.

bands_runtime.precision: Original CUDA autocast inference; bands internal FP32
